name: yeVykhid
source:
Perhaps one day people will learn to digitize consciousness after death so that it continues to live in an ideal but virtual world. As in the Black Mirror series 'San Junipero'.

But here's what we thought: this system will be created from scratch by people (with the help of artificial intelligence, of course). And where there are people, there are human errors.

In 'єВихід' you play as the first tester of the virtual afterlife. After a massive system failure, you need to recover your data to continue your digital life. Will you manage?

[translated from [url=https://chichka.itch.io/wayway]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
也许有一天，人们会学会将死后的意识数字化，使其继续生活在一个理想但虚拟的世界中。正如黑镜系列“圣朱尼佩罗”中那样。

但我们的想法是：这个系统将由人们从头开始创建（当然，在人工智能的帮助下）。有人的地方就会有人为错误。

在“єВихід”中，你将扮演虚拟来世的第一位测试者。在发生大规模系统故障后，你需要恢复数据以继续你的数字生活。你会管理吗？

[译自[url=https://chichka.itch.io/wayway]itch.io[/url]]
